why: All three checks pass; the finding survives. (1) QUOTE VERBATIM. curl -sL https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/mcp.md, line 375 reads in full: "For the streamable HTTP transport, use `\"type\": \"http\"` instead. In `.mcp.json` and other JSON config files, `\"streamable-http\"` is accepted as an alias for `\"http\"`. The programmatic `mcpServers` option accepts only `\"http\"`." The claimed sentence is the middle sentence, character-for-character. The third sentence is the second-half trap and it does NOT reverse the conclusion: it restricts the alias to JSON config files, which is exactly the surface our parser owns. agent-sdk/mcp is row 32 of scripts/claude-doc-pages.tsv, so it is a Claude contract page, not a Codex/MCP-registry page. (2) CITED FILES CONFIRMED. packages/shared/src/mcp/project-config.ts:119 `if (type === 'http' || type === 'sse')`, :144 `if (type === 'ws')`, :163 `if (type === undefined || type === 'stdio')`, :177 `return null` — a closed set with no alias arm; :211 emits `Ignoring ${label} server "${slug}": unsupported MCP server config`. The adapter's closed set is real but the line drifted: it is packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters/claude.ts:1040 (`rawTransport === 'stdio' || 'http' || 'sse' || 'ws'`), not :1034, which is inside the preceding comment. (3) CONSEQUENCE TESTED SEPARATELY, WITH A POSITIVE CONTROL. Ran parseMcpServersDocument over two entries in one document: {type:'http',url:...} and {type:'streamable-http',url:...}. Output: only `control_http` survives; warnings = ["Ignoring .mcp.json server \"alias_streamable\": unsupported MCP server config"]. The control proves the rig works, so the absence is a real absence. LAYER UP: no normalizer exists between file and parser. `grep -a` for streamable-http across packages/ and apps/*/src returns zero hits in our own source; the same closed set is repeated independently at codex.ts:905, native-sources.ts:454, plugins/schema.ts:624, mcp-pool.ts:183 and plugins/types.ts:170, so nothing upstream rewrites the value. LAYER DOWN: the vendored alias is real and does NOT rescue the entry. apps/electron/dist/resources/pi-agent-server/index.js and session-mcp-server/index.js carry the SDK's own zod schema `z.enum(["http","streamable-http"]).transform(() => "http")`, and main.cjs carries the bare enum constant — matching the claim that it lives only in vendored bundles. But Pi is handed an explicit `Record<string, SdkMcpServerConfig>` (pi-agent.ts:7014, base-agent.ts:1698) already filtered by our parser; the `.mcp.json` strings inside the Pi bundle are the SDK's settings-schema descriptions (enabledMcpjsonServers/disabledMcpjsonServers), not an independent workspace read on our path. So the entry is dropped before any vendored schema could coerce it. NOT AN OWNER DECISION: none of the nine dated decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3 concerns the MCP transport alias, and grep -a for streamable-http across docs/superpowers/plans and the parity audit returns nothing. NOT A PRODUCT DIFFERENCE: this is generic MCP transport-name parsing, unrelated to the dropped subscription flows, the corporate gateway, or the NESSY_ rename.
correctedState: Confirmed with two citation corrections and one path correction. The `.mcp.json` reader `parseProjectMcpServer` (packages/shared/src/mcp/project-config.ts:119-177) branches on `'http'|'sse'`, then `'ws'`, then `undefined|'stdio'`, and returns null otherwise; `parseMcpServersDocument:211` then logs `Ignoring .mcp.json server "<name>": unsupported MCP server config` and drops the entry. Measured, with an `http` positive control in the same document: `{"type":"streamable-http","url":...}` is dropped, `{"type":"http",...}` survives. The Claude plugin adapter's identical closed set is at format-adapters/claude.ts:1040 (the claim cited :1034, which is comment text); the Codex adapter (codex.ts:905) and native-sources.ts:454 use the same closed set minus `ws`. Also correct the live path: the exported `loadProjectMcpServers` helper has NO production caller (test-only, base-agent.test.ts:803); the shipped `.mcp.json` read is runtime-pool-servers.ts:461 via the capability materializer, plus capabilities/project-contribution-detect.ts:129 for contribution detection — both funnel through the same `parseMcpServersDocument`, so the drop and the warning are identical on the live path. The alias does exist in the vendored bundles exactly as claimed (`z.enum(["http","streamable-http"]).transform(() => "http")` in apps/electron/dist/resources/pi-agent-server/index.js and session-mcp-server/index.js), but it cannot rescue the entry: Pi receives an already-parsed `Record<string, SdkMcpServerConfig>` and does not read the workspace `.mcp.json` itself. Fix is a one-line alias normalization at project-config.ts:118 (`const type = raw.type === 'streamable-http' ? 'http' : raw.type`) plus the matching arm in claude.ts:1040.
